title: Yucata Game Result Final Score Leaderboard
dataSources: Video-game sessions (`game:session`), achievement unlocks (`achievement:unlock`), board-game plays (`boardgame:play`), chess games (`chess:game`), dice rolls (`dice:roll`).
app: Gaming and tabletop telemetry — Steam / PSN / Xbox playtime and achievement APIs, BoardGameGeek plays export, Lichess / Chess.com game archives, and tabletop dice-roller logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=yucata:game score=*
| stats sum(score) as total_value, avg(score) as avg_value by game_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks game values by total and average final score across Yucata game result events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `score` values for each Yucata game result event and review total and average final score by game.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total final score.
grandmaExplanation: It smartly which game shows the biggest final score numbers in your Yucata game result data.
